label: preparing
what: A surprise celebration of my forty years of service, disguised as the eighteen o'clock hospitality meeting in the great hall. The secretary explicitly reported Builder's description of a service-anniversary surprise, eight installed lanterns, bread purchases and planned supplies coordinated by the innkeeper. Freight was seen delivering bread to a hall table chest. Secretary knowingly assists with arrangements and my attendance, though disclosed the surprise to me. Baker's knowing involvement and neighbour's involvement are not established.
